title: brasil mod
description: A cultural expansion in development that brings the historic Pau-Brasil tree, custom logs, and unique red planks to your Minecraft world.
body:
# 🇧🇷 BRASIL CRAFT 

### 🚀 Welcome to the ultimate Brazilian cultural expansion for Minecraft!

**⚠️ PROJECT STATUS:** This mod is currently in early **BETA**. We are starting our journey by introducing the most iconic and historic vegetation directly into the world generation engine!

---

## ❌ There's no armor, just unique nature!
This project is **100% focused on bringing real Brazilian elements to the game**. There are absolutely **NO armor sets or weapons** in this mod!

---

## 🌳 Current Features (Beta v1.0):
* **🪵 Pau-Brasil Tree:** Explore your world to naturally find the legendary Pau-Brasil trees! Includes custom logs and tropical leaf blocks engineered for NeoForge 1.21.1.
* **🟥 Pau-Brasil Planks:** Use the crafting table to transform your logs into beautiful, vivid reddish wood planks to build your tropical bases!

---

## 🛠️ Platform & Metadata:
* **Modloader:** NeoForge 1.21.1
* **License:** MIT License 

_Download the Beta now, chop down some Pau-Brasil, and experience the historic red wood inside your world!_
